beats.say: Rod Stewart dominated MTV’s launch, appearing 16 times in the first day.
MTV began broadcasting on 1 August 1981, kicking off with the Buggles' Video Killed the Radio Star.
That iconic video was the very first music video ever aired on the new channel.
Just after, Pat Benatar’s You Better Run played as the second video, but Stewart’s tracks kept returning.
In total, 116 unique videos filled the first 24 hours, yet Stewart’s eleven videos were shown 16 times, the most of any artist.
So Rod Stewart set the record for the busiest debut on MTV, a fact many still miss.
Did you know which other artist topped the early MTV playlist?
